title: Food Assistance During the Federal Government Shutdown
description:
If you receive CalFresh benefits, you have likely heard about the current federal government shutdown and its impact to your CalFresh benefits.    Here’s what you need to know:

The shutdown means that the federal government will not be authorizing CalFresh benefits for the month of November 2025. Once the shutdown ends, benefits will be issued to those who were eligible in the month of November. 

If your CalFresh SAR 7 or annual renewal is due during the shutdown, you MUST complete them on time to remain eligible so that you may continue to receive your benefits once the shutdown ends. 

We encourage you to visit your local food pantry and to connect with your local mutual aid organizations for assistance during this difficult time. 

For a list of locations, please visit LAFoodBank.org or contact 211 by dialing 2-1-1 or visiting www.211.org.
